title: Chat can use your own Pollen
summary:
Bring your own Pollen to chat, make or edit images with `klein`, and try Alpha web research with `nomnom`.

Community contributor CloudCompile added Bring Your Own Pollen to chat.pollinations.ai. Connect through Enter to use your own API key for model listings, chat, images, and video; the sidebar shows your Pollen balance, and you can disconnect to return to the default key.

FLUX.2 [klein] 4B was added for text-to-image generation and editing with reference images. Its primary ID is `klein`, with `flux-klein` retained as an alias.

The community model `nomnom` was added for web search, scraping, and crawling, with its capabilities marked Alpha. `gemini-scrape` and `web-research` remain aliases; the same work removed configured token-limit defaults and overrides across several models.

highlights.title: Bring Pollen to chat
highlights.text: Connect your Enter account to use your own API key for chat, images, and video, and check your Pollen balance in the sidebar. Disconnect to return to the default key. [Open community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Meet FLUX Klein
highlights.text: Generate images or edit them with reference images using `klein`. The `flux-klein` alias works too. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=klein).

highlights.title: NomNom researches the web
highlights.text: Try the Alpha `nomnom` text model for web search, scraping, and crawling. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nomnom).
